scripts.tauri:clean-ports: export SCYTHE_FRONTEND_PORT=${SCYTHE_FRONTEND_PORT:-5173}; export SCYTHE_BACKEND_PORT=${SCYTHE_BACKEND_PORT:-3001}; export VITE_BACKEND_PORT=$SCYTHE_BACKEND_PORT; for PORT in "$SCYTHE_FRONTEND_PORT" "$SCYTHE_BACKEND_PORT"; do PIDS="$(lsof -nP -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t || true)"; if [ -n "$PIDS" ]; then echo "Killing orphan process(es) on TCP port $PORT: $PIDS"; kill -9 $PIDS; fi; done
